name: Air Jordan 4 Retro 'Black Cat' 2006
story_html: The Air Jordan 4 ‘Black Cat’ focuses on simplicity, featuring a Triple Black color scheme that’s constructed with nubuck paneling on the upper and charcoal accents on the webbing, branding and eyelets. Similar to a majority of retro Jordan 4 offerings, this silhouette showcases the Jumpman icon on the heel, as opposed to the Nike Air branding.
